summary: Comprehensive testing of The Wi Shop e-commerce platform after migration from mocked frontend to real FastAPI + MongoDB backend. All 21 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing confirmed: Homepage displays products grouped by category, Login flow works for both shop owner and super admin, Shop Owner Dashboard shows stats/products/categories/orders with full CRUD, Storefront checkout flow works end-to-end with thank-you page, Super Admin Dashboard shows system stats and management tabs.

issues: Console warning: DialogContent requires DialogTitle for accessibility - recommend adding VisuallyHidden DialogTitle
